title: HungerStation materials
subtitle: The list of materials offered to HungerStation, and which of them are disabled or deleted.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the HungerStation catalog grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

filters.qPlaceholder: Start of a material number or SKU, or part of a name

results.failedTitle: The materials could not be loaded
results.failed: Something went wrong while loading the materials. Try again in a moment.

change.title: Change the material
change.note: A disabled material is not offered to HungerStation until it is enabled again. A deleted one is taken off the list HungerStation reads.
change.gone: This material is no longer in the HungerStation list. The list has been read again.
change.goneHint: The material is not in the HungerStation list.

import.title: Import the material list
import.note: Each row sets one material's disabled and deleted flags. A material not yet in the list is added; a number the material master does not have is not.
import.format: One row per material: the material number, then X if it is disabled, then X if it is deleted (true and false read too). Paste from Excel, or pick a sheet.

file.unreadable: {{fileName}} could not be read as a workbook. Save it as .xlsx, or paste the rows.

preview.header: The first line, <header>{{header}}</header>, is read as a header and skipped.

problems.title_one: <n>{{n}}</n> row cannot be sent. Fix it or take it out:
problems.title_other: <n>{{n}}</n> rows cannot be sent. Fix them or take them out:
problems.material: Line <line>{{line}}</line>: <value>{{value}}</value> is not a material number.
problems.mark: Line <line>{{line}}</line>: <value>{{value}}</value> is not a mark. Use X or leave it blank.
